tools.quote: Using an AI agent within Learn or any other University learning or assessment platform which requires you to log in is not permitted.

tools.name: ELM
tools.quote: All University of Edinburgh students have free access to ELM (Edinburgh access to Language Models), which offers you a secure gateway to a range of generative AI models.

tools.name: ELM
tools.quote: The university encourages you to use ELM over other platforms such as GPT, DeepSeek, Grok etc for the following reasons:
As a result, you must not use third-party AI-based translation apps in class.
You should only use the University’s generative AI service – ELM – to do this as it has in-built privacy protections.

data.quote: Sharing your login details with an agent or agentic browser is a breach of the University Computing Acceptable Use Policy.

safeguards.quote: You should only use the University’s generative AI service – ELM – to do this as it has in-built privacy protections.
In ELM your data is secure – it will not be retained by third party services to train their models or for any other purpose.
